summary.headline: Astrological Weather and Lunar Eclipses
summary.text: Astrological weather rules use the solar ingress into Aries and quarterly or monthly figures to predict rain, winds, heat, dryness, frost, snow, discord, pestilence, and scarcity from planetary conjunctions, signs, and planetary rulers. Chapter V, “On the Eclipse of the Moon and its Signification,” begins with rules for interpreting lunar and solar eclipses through the eclipse ascendant, its ruler, malefics, fortunes, and cold signs.
